content:
The poem references Frederick V (the "Winter King") losing both his Palatinate lands along the Rhine and his claim to the Bohemian throne (Prague) after his defeat in the early Thirty Years' War.  
The line "stay away / Alike from Rhine and Prague" indicates these are territories he once controlled or claimed but lost after the Battle of White Mountain (1620).  
Option (B) fits best because it directly reflects the historical outcome — he lost these lands in conflict and was forced into exile.  

Final answer: (B)
